original.text: namaḥ samayasārāya svānubhūtyā cakāsate / citsvabhāvāya bhāvāya sarvabhāvāntaracchide
original.edition: recalled by the unit author (wording believed standard; to be checked against an edition)

paraphrase: Homage to the essence of the self (samayasāra), which shines by self-experience, whose nature is consciousness, and which cuts through all other states.
notes: Verse number recalled, not checked; the content is the unit author's recollection (skeleton).

original.text: bhedavijñānataḥ siddhāḥ siddhā ye kila kecana / asyaivābhāvato baddhā baddhā ye kila kecana
original.edition: recalled by the unit author (wording believed standard; to be checked against an edition)

paraphrase: Whoever are liberated are liberated through discriminative knowledge; whoever are bound are bound through its absence.
notes: Verse number recalled, not checked; the content is the unit author's recollection (skeleton).
